flags.why: This sense also applies to favorable opportunities, so restricting it to something unpleasant is misleading ([usage example](https://vnexpress.net/viet-nam-dung-truoc-co-hoi-du-u17-world-cup-4809298.html)).
flags.fix: to be faced with; to have ahead of one (a situation, challenge, or opportunity)

flags.why: The entry omits the common meaning of extreme emotional pain or sorrow ([dictionary](https://vdict.com/%C4%91%E1%BB%A9t%20ru%E1%BB%99t%2C3%2C0%2C0.html)).
flags.fix: adj | heartbroken; deeply distressed; ex: Nhìn con đau đớn, mẹ thương đứt ruột. = Seeing her child in pain broke the mother's heart.
